content.short: DeFi Kingdoms is a gamified decentralized finance game with on-chain NFTs, originally built on Harmony and later expanded to Avalanche as Crystalvale.
content.description: DeFi Kingdoms is a gamified decentralized finance experience that originally launched on the Harmony blockchain. Players explore a pixelated world, undertake in-game quests, and acquire rare items and resources. All characters within the DeFi Kingdoms universe are represented as on-chain NFTs that can be bought and sold on an open market, enabling players to collect, trade, and cultivate their in-game assets. After its initial success, the project expanded to the Avalanche network under the name Crystalvale.
